title: Scalar extension under the continuous integral and rational module encodings
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite-dimensional normed extension of Q_ell, X a scheme, and M a module sheaf over the integral lisse coefficient sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients]. For the specified encodings FI and FE of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding], FE applied to ordinary internal scalar extension of FI.inverse(M) along the integral coefficient inclusion is isomorphic to the sheafified sectionwise change of rings of M along lisseIntegerToField. The isomorphism compares the specified objects, without any local freeness hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 03D7 (extension-restriction adjunction), Tags 03EK and 03EL (sheafified tensor and pullback); Bhatt--Scholze, Section 6.8

proof.text: Use Classical.choose_spec of the proved public exists_changeOfRingsMap theorem to recover the pure-tensor restriction formula, without importing any private upstream theorem. Sectionwise HomEquiv.toRestrictScalars sends f to m ↦ f(1 tensor m); its naturality follows from that formula and naturality_apply. Sectionwise HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars gives the inverse, whose naturality follows by ExtendScalars.hom_ext and the same formula on 1 tensor m. The inverse laws are the sectionwise homEquiv inverse laws. Compose this equivalence with sheafificationHomEquiv; sheafificationAdjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right proves naturality in the target. Adjunction.leftAdjointOfEquiv and adjunctionOfEquivLeft give the required functor with object function exactly changeOfRings.

Transport continuousRing_comap_compatibility through the integral and field coefficient isomorphisms. The lisseScalar_square identity makes the remaining coefficient-square comparison identity on underlying sections.

Compose the internal extension-restriction adjunction with the two encoding equivalences. The previous natural isomorphism identifies its right adjoint with sectionwise scalar restriction. Uniqueness of left adjoints compares the specified scalar-extension objects, using the equality of the constructed functor object with changeOfRings.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousModuleEncoding_scalar_extension
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (lisseIntegerSheaf ℓ E X))) :
    Nonempty ((continuousFieldModuleEquivalence ℓ E X).functor.obj
        ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
          ((continuousIntegerModuleEquivalence ℓ E X).inverse.obj M)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u + 1, u + 1} (lisseIntegerToField ℓ E X) M)
